name: Leonardo · Leonardo

title.zh: Leonardo · 先看顺序色阶与默认灰阶的当前

description.zh: 看默认Gray六格及实际页面比值标注。 Leonardo提供界面主题、数据可视化色阶和颜色工具箱，用当前色板、色码与示例图帮助起草设计系统配色。官方项目软件按Apache-2.0公开，网页服务价格及输入、导出视觉资产的独立授权未确认，页面比值不构成本次无障碍符合性测量。
description.en: Leonardo offers workspaces for interface themes, data-visualization scales and color tools. Its current pages display color codes, example charts and contrast labels. The official project software is Apache-2.0, while service pricing and independent input or output rights remain unconfirmed. These observations do not establish accessibility compliance.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Leonardo (https://leonardocolor.io/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看默认Gray六格及实际页面比值标注。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页的主题、色阶和工具箱三个入口，再对照顺序色阶页的七色色码、矩阵、散点和地图示例。主题页当前只是Gray默认六格，标出的是页面给出的对比度数值；此次未改色、上传、导出或测量无障碍符合性。它适合起草设计系统与图表配色，Apache许可只按已核软件范围记录，不能由源码公开推断网页免费，输入与导出资产权利另核。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
